{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) and refunded orders
df_clean = df[(df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute conversion rates by channel
converted_by_channel = df_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].agg(['mean', 'count'])

# Extract the counts and means
email_count = converted_by_channel.loc['email', 'count']
email_mean = converted_by_channel.loc['email', 'mean']
paid_search_count = converted_by_channel.loc['paid_search', 'count']
paid_search_mean = converted_by_channel.loc['paid_search', 'mean']

# Compute the difference
conversion_diff = email_mean - paid_search_mean

# Print all required values
print(f"Email conversion rate: {email_mean}")
print(f"Email count: {email_count}")
print(f"Paid search conversion rate: {paid_search_mean}")
print(f"Paid search count: {paid_search_count}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {conversion_diff}")"}
